notes.title: Release of Demo Version
notes.notes:
Get ready! The demo for TWIN SOUL is now available on Steam, offering a glimpse into our early development. 🎮 Experience a trance-inducing music action game set in ancient Japan and get a first taste of what's to come!


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3904670/Twin_Soul_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]
